name: Rival Attacks
notes: Roll if you are being attacked by a Rival. If you tracked them down, you always fight a Showdown. There is no Win condition against Rivals, but if you Hold the Field, you have an increased chance of permanently chasing them off. If you flee from the battle before 4 rounds are up, a random crew member will lose a random item of equipment carried in your flight.

rows.detail: You can deploy one crew member less than standard (5 in a typical campaign) for this fight, and cannot roll to Seize the Initiative.
Add one additional enemy figure. Your crew must all set up in or adjacent to a building. If you fail to Hold the Field, you will lose 1D3 credits.
If you fail to Hold the Field, your ship will take 1D6+1 points of Hull Point damage.
